product_metadata.title: Sooyee Stackable Refrigerator Bin - (6 x 12 Inch) - w/Handle - BPA Free Polyethylene - for Fridge, Freezer, Pantry Organization - Kitchen,Clear - Set of 4
features: Set of 4 large plastic storage bins great for creating a clean and organized refrigerator or pantry; Ideal for yogurts, canned goods, food packets, cheese, meat, drink boxes, baby food, juices, boxed foods,pet food, potatoes, onions, and apples; Great for storing dry goods in the pantry; Stack these or use side by side to create the storage solution that works best for you; Maximize storage space in refrigerator, freezer, cabinets, cupboards, pantry shelves or inside drawers.

Built-in Handles easy-grip side handles make it easy to transport from shelf to table or island; Organize all of your kitchen essentials and create handy go-to supply baskets to make organizing and everyday living a little easier; Store kitchen essentials: towels, candles, baking supplies, straws, and skewers; Easily stacks to create space-saving vertical storage - just rotate 180° to stack bins ; Use multiples and different sizes to create a custom storage system, stack or use.

Versatile for any place you need:Craft rooms, laundry/utility rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens, offices, garages, toy room, playroom and more; Light weight and easy to transport, these are great in apartments, condos, dorm rooms, RVs, campers and more.
Made of durable, food-safe PETG thermoplastic,transparent design saves space and allows you to easily see what’s inside.Easily cleaned in the sink with soapy water.
Thoughtfully Size: Available in 4 sizes.This 'Medium' bin dimensions measure 12.4"(L) x 6.1"(W) x 3.5"(H)
